description.zh-CN: 九十年代的 Windows 桌面。收纳桌面就是磁盘碎片整理，一键收工就是“关闭程序”对话框，系统状态放进“资源状况”。
description.en: A 1995 Windows desktop. Tidying the desktop is literally defragmentation, winding down is the Close Program dialog, and system readings live in the Resource Meter.

concept.world: A Windows 95 desktop at the end of a work day: teal background, grey bevelled windows, a cluster map.
concept.mood: Nostalgic and tactile. Everything is a window you could have used in 1995, and each one really works.
concept.type: MS Sans Serif / Tahoma at small sizes; SimSun for Chinese, as the Chinese edition of Windows 95 used.
concept.motion: Only what the old programs did: blocks being read and written, a segmented progress bar, a blinking disk light.

metaphors.tidy-files.pending: Each loose desktop file is a fragmented file scattered across the cluster map
metaphors.tidy-files.run: Defragment: blocks are read (green), written (red) and settle as optimized data (blue)
metaphors.quit-apps.run: End All in the Close Program dialog, which lists the programs it will ask to quit
metaphors.system: The Resource Meter: CPU, memory, disk and battery as segmented bars
metaphors.clock: The tray clock in the status bar
metaphors.weather: A line in the Resource Meter status bar
